title: In vivo passive lower-back bending stiffness, relaxation and energy dissipation in upright passive flexion (40 deg and 70% of range), by age group and sex
quantity: average lower-back bending stiffness K = (Me - Ms)/(theta_e - theta_s)
unit: mixed: Nm, Nm rad, Nm/rad, deg, ratio
condition: passive flexion in upright frame (EMG monitored for no change)
notes: Single-study group; quantity definitions differ between studies in this category, so cross-study pooling was not done.
